contribution_types.description:
Vina spent 10 minutes giving feedback on the winning variant. I specifically asked for her to focus on what doesn’t work with this product

_PS: meanwhile I been working through this bottle to determine how high a dosage I can consumed before I get sated to the point of being sick and tired of the taste._

_6 almonds seems to be where the tipping from bliss to sated happens 🤔_

_Gut feeling tells me 50/50 the USA market might not be receptive to this._

_What I hate about this_

- _it dries the mouth_. 

- ⁠_the almonds don’t just totally crumble after the initial crunch. Ideal experience would be for it to totally fall apart after a very potent initial crunch_

- ⁠_some portions of it remain chewy after falling apart and at some point feels like chewing chalk_
